positions.company: CONA Services LLC (Coca-Cola North American Bottling Ecosystem)
positions.title: SAP Integration Suite Consultant
positions.description:
Designed and delivered SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration interfaces connecting Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and SAP S/4HANA across Order-to-Cash processes.
Built CPI iFlows for quote-to-order, sales orders, order acknowledgements, inventory, pricing, delivery, billing, and order status.
Integrated Salesforce REST APIs with SAP S/4HANA using REST/HTTPS, IDoc, and OData, with validation, routing, transformation, and exception handling.
Designed and governed APIs using SAP API Management, OAuth 2.0, certificates, mTLS, throttling, security policies, and analytics.
Onboarded trading partners using ANSI X12, EDIFACT, AS2, SFTP, Trading Partner Management, and Integration Advisor.
Developed graphical, XSLT, and Groovy mappings to validate, enrich, route, and transform partner-specific payloads.
Implemented asynchronous integration patterns using SAP Advanced Event Mesh and JMS.
Configured secure connectivity using SAP Cloud Connector, OAuth 2.0, X.509 certificates, TLS/mTLS, and SFTP.
Improved reliability through retry and recovery, idempotency, duplicate prevention, correlation IDs, and SAP Cloud ALM monitoring.
Led integration testing and managed deployments through Cloud Transport Management and CI/CD, supporting cutover, go-live, and hypercare.
achievements: Delivered 25+ end-to-end CPI interfaces connecting Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and SAP S/4HANA across Order-to-Cash processes.
Built and maintained integrations supporting 50K+ messages per day across sales orders, inventory, pricing, delivery, billing, and order status.
Applied API security and governance standards across 20+ enterprise interfaces.
Onboarded 15+ trading partners using B2B/EDI, Trading Partner Management, and Integration Advisor, reducing onboarding time by 30%.
Implemented SAP Advanced Event Mesh and JMS integration patterns supporting 25K+ events per day.
Reduced unplanned outages by 40% and error-resolution time by 35% through improved exception handling, recovery, and monitoring.
Resolved 50+ defects during SIT, UAT, regression, negative, EDI-partner, and performance testing.

positions.title: SAP Integration Consultant
positions.description:
Delivered SAP S/4HANA Cloud logistics integration for transport-demand automation across order-to-delivery processes, applying SAP SD/LE and Transportation Management integration patterns.
Built SAP Integration Suite / CPI scenarios using standard integration patterns and SAP APIs to exchange logistics and transportation data between S/4HANA Cloud and external systems.
Integrated sales orders, outbound deliveries, and transportation demands, automating the conversion of logistics documents into planning-ready Freight Units.
Owned SAP TM processes covering Freight Unit creation, Freight Order planning, transportation execution, carrier coordination, and freight settlement.
Configured transportation relevance, control keys, freight-unit building rules, shipping conditions, and logistics settings to automate transportation-demand creation.
Monitored and resolved failed messages, API errors, mapping issues, master-data inconsistencies, and document-processing exceptions.
Executed SIT, UAT, and regression testing across the Order-to-Transport lifecycle.
Supported cutover, deployment, go-live, and hypercare through interface validation, master-data verification, connectivity checks, and production monitoring.
achievements: Delivered S/4HANA Cloud logistics integrations connecting order and delivery processes with transportation-demand creation.
Automated the conversion of sales orders and outbound deliveries into planning-ready Freight Units.
Supported the Order-to-Transport lifecycle, including Freight Order planning, execution updates, carrier coordination, and freight settlement.
Reduced incident resolution time by 30% through troubleshooting of integration, mapping, master-data, and document-processing issues.
Executed 30+ end-to-end test scenarios covering order creation, delivery processing, Freight Unit generation, Freight Order planning, execution updates, and freight settlement.
Supported production readiness, cutover, go-live, and hypercare.
